camel_example: aliyun rds CreateAccount --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --AccountName test1 --AccountPassword Test123456
description_zh: 该接口用于创建数据库账号
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-account --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --account-name test1 --account-password Test123456 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610396.html to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account.

The name must be unique and can contain uppercase letters (supported only by MySQL), lowercase letters, digits, or underscores. For specific naming conventions, refer to the tutorials for each engine: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96089.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96753.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95810.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97132.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号名称。

该名称必须唯一，且由大写字母（仅MySQL支持）、小写字母、数字或下划线组成。账号命名具体限制，请参见各引擎教程：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96089.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/96753.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95810.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/97132.html
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account.
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters (`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号的密码。
长度为8~32个字符。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符（`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`）中的任意三种组成
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The description of the account. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, Chinese characters, letters, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
The description cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
账号描述，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: account_description

parameters.help_en:
The account type. Valid values:

Normal (default): standard account.
Super: privileged user. You can create at most one privileged user per instance.
Sysadmin (ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server only): database account with SA permissions. Before creating this account, check whether the instance meets the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170736.html.
GlobalRO (ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server only): global read-only account. You can create at most two global read-only accounts per instance. The database engine version must be SQL Server 2016 or later, and the instance type must be dedicated or general-purpose
parameters.help_zh:
账号类型，取值：

Normal（默认值）：普通账号。
Super：高权限账号，每个实例至多创建一个。
Sysadmin（仅SQL Server实例）：SA权限的数据库账号。创建前请先检查实例是否满足https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170736.html。
GlobalRO（仅SQL Server实例）：全局只读账号，每个实例至多创建两个。实例数据库版本需为SQL Server 2016及以上且实例规格族为独享型或通用型
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_en:
The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2845728.html of the SQL Server instance. Valid values:
true: The policy is applied.
false: The policy is not applied.
If you set this parameter to true, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848317.html in advance.
This parameter is not supported for SQL Server https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57184.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145468.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/603466.html instances
parameters.help_zh:

true：应用策略
false：不应用策略
设置为true时，必须预先https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848317.html。
该参数不支持SQL Serverhttps://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57184.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145468.html以及https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/603466.html的实例
